text: Ok now give the uv better control. scroll wheel for zoom, middle mouse for panning, right click context menu functions rather than a bunch of buttons would be better
resolution: Reworked the active cart/editor UV workspace around direct canvas control: raw host onScroll now performs cursor-anchored wheel zoom, the host middle-button route polls the live SDL mask for smooth middle-drag panning, and the former multi-row UV/texture button stack is consolidated into a grouped right-click menu. The compact header keeps mode, zoom, island count, and input hints visible while returning vertical space to the atlas.
